Schema: Products (product_id INT, name VARCHAR, category VARCHAR, price DECIMAL), Inventory (product_id INT, quantity INT, last_updated DATE).

5. Update the quantity of an existing product.

    P.name,
    P.category,
    P.price,
    I.quantity
FROM

    name,
    price,
    quantity
FROM
    Products
JOIN
    Inventory ON Products.product_id = Inventory.product_id

    category = 'Electronics';

SELECT
    SUM(P.price * I.quantity) AS total_inventory_value
FROM
    Products AS P
JOIN
    Inventory AS I ON P.product_id = I.product_id;

    a.artist_name

    a.artist_name
FROM
    Songs s
JOIN
    Artists a ON s.artist_id = a.artist_id

    PlaylistSongs ps ON s.song_id = ps.song_id
JOIN
    Playlists p ON ps.playlist_id = p.playlist_id

    p.playlist_name = 'Workout Jams';

    a.artist_name,
    COUNT(s.song_id) AS total_songs
FROM
    Artists a
LEFT JOIN
    Songs s ON a.artist_id = s.artist_id
GROUP BY
    a.artist_name
ORDER BY
